episodes.problem: An interrupted container could lose task state and temporary installations.
episodes.observation: Operator incident timing and persistent application logs bounded the failure window.

artifact_change.description: Maintain durable project progress and active task handoffs, preserve run identity and evidence, and prepare a private harness account recovery route.

episodes.validation: The source archive retains a platform probe error at the container interruption boundary.
episodes.adoption: Later IPR, overlapping, and staggered experiments used independent run directories and persistent handoffs.
limits: Actual account credentials and login backups remain in user-controlled private storage.
Account restoration follows the selected harness authentication mechanism.
A sampled wait channel does not identify the lock holder.

episodes.problem: Probe phases and heartbeat intervals exceeded limits without an automatic stop.
episodes.observation: Intermediate events reset the phase timer and newer heartbeats obscured previous long gaps.

artifact_change.description: Track phase starts per probe ID and inspect completed duration, active age, and every heartbeat interval.

episodes.validation: Replay detected five launch and three heartbeat violations while the historical successful waves passed.
episodes.adoption: Independent waves completed; a later staggered wave exercised the repaired stop mechanism.
limits: Protection thresholds were agreed for the specific experiment.
A successful independent run does not establish a long-term failure rate.

episodes.problem: CPU and GPU overlap was intended to reduce total completion time.
episodes.observation: The first staggered wave passed and the second recorded a launch of about 6.041 seconds.

artifact_change.description: Gate insertion on progressing workers and host health, then monitor each wave and reassess remaining work after a stop.

episodes.validation: The controller stopped IPR wave02, pLDDT completed, and the full overlap experiment remained unsuccessful.
episodes.adoption: This counterexample bounds the current staggering guidance.
limits: Full-workload overlap has not passed acceptance under this configuration.
Startup contention is not an established sole cause.
